description: This file defines the Validations class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, responsible for validating cell addresses, cell ranges, and related references within spreadsheet worksheets.

classes.name: Validations
classes.description: Provides static methods for validating cell addresses, cell ranges, and named references within a spreadsheet worksheet.

methods.name: validateCellAddress
methods.description: Validates and formats a cell address provided as a string, array, or CellAddress object, returning a standardized string format.

methods.name: validateCellOrCellRange
methods.description: Validates and formats a cell or cell range, accepting various input types including string, array, or object.

methods.name: validateCellRange
methods.description: Validates and formats a cell range, handling string representations or array inputs, and converting column/row ranges.

methods.name: definedNameToCoordinate
methods.description: Resolves a named coordinate to its actual cell reference within a worksheet, considering defined names.
